<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex088052025-05-2615-53-57" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="2331.4 log shes"/>
         <milestone unit="section" n="2331.41 mtshan nyid"/>
         log shes kyi spyi'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> ni don dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs> bzhed pa <note type="editorial">The ascription of this view to Phya pa seems mistaken. A similar view is ascribed to  (ID:3864) in work (ID:5507), and it is mentioned anonymously in work (ID:4771)</note> mi 'thad de | dngos po'i don dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa yin na | <lb n="9a4"/> dngos <expan>med</expan> 'jal ba'i tshad ma <note type="gloss">log shes su thal bas</note> la khyab ches la | shes bya'i don dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa yin na zla 2 la de <expan>med</expan> pas de log shes ma yin par thal lo ||</seg></TEI>
